# Adorise Digital

> Autonomous AI Growth Fleet, Micro-SaaS Suite, and Digital Publishing House. Founded by Sanjay Shharma (IIM Calcutta Alumni).

Adorise Digital (a division of Trendy DigiStore LLC, Wyoming, USA) builds, operates, and deploys autonomous AI systems, executive productivity tools, and bestselling life-stage publication frameworks.

## Core Divisions & Services

- [Autonomous AI Services](https://adorisedigital.com/services/): Fixed-price autonomous growth fleets for B2B enterprises.
  - AI Lead Generation & Intent Radar ($297/mo): 100+ verified decision-makers delivered weekly via social buying intent monitoring.
  - AI Content Omnipresence ($197/mo): 30–60 multimodal posts/month published autonomously across LinkedIn, X, and YouTube.
  - AI Customer Service & Voice Agents ($147/mo): 24/7 ticket and voice triage resolving issues in under 60 seconds.
  - Complete AI Automation Suite ($497/mo): Unified end-to-end pipeline (Leads + Content + Customer Service).
- [Scout B2B Intent Radar](https://adorisedigital.com/scout/): Real-time social intent listening across X, Reddit, and LinkedIn capturing commercial software and agency queries.
- [Outreach Engine](https://adorisedigital.com/outreach/): Automated lead qualification rubric (scoring >= 75) and personalized cold outreach via self-hosted Composio API.

## Micro-SaaS Product Suite

- [InboxCalm](https://adorisedigital.com/inboxcalm/): AI-powered email firewall detecting hostility, filtering noise, and auto-drafting de-escalating replies to protect executive mental peace.
- [ClipCalm AI](https://adorisedigital.com/clipcalm/): Automated 9:16 vertical video reframing and viral hook extraction, eliminating creator weekend editing fatigue.
- [DearMee AI](https://adorisedigital.com/dearmee/): Confidential neural companion and non-judgmental executive sounding board preventing burnout and decision fatigue.

## Publishing & Digital Assets: The Care Collection

- [Adorise Books Storefront](https://books.adorisedigital.com): 48-book digital asset catalog spanning Marital Reconnection, Family Caregiving, AI Leadership, and Wealth Preservation.
- [Hum Ladte Nahi, Par Baat Nahi Karte](https://adorisedigital.gumroad.com/l/hum-ladte-nahi): 14-chapter + 4-toolkit relationship framework by Sanjay Shharma (IIM Calcutta Alumni) addressing silent marriages in urban Indian homes.
- [Still Married, Just Silent](https://adorisedigital.gumroad.com/l/Still_Married_Just_Silent): Global English edition (208 pages) on restarting intimacy and communication in silent marriages.
- [The Quiet Care](https://adorisedigital.gumroad.com/l/the-quiet-care): Practical caregiver survival handbook for families navigating chronic illness and Alzheimer's.
